claims.statement: The numpy-financial library provides a core set of financial functions, including fv, pv, pmt, nper, rate, ipmt, ppmt, npv, irr, mirr, and simple_interest, designed for financial analysis.
numpy-financial functions support scalar, array, and decimal.Decimal inputs, enabling high-precision and vectorized calculations via NumPy broadcasting.

Financial functions in numpy-financial are designed to behave like NumPy ufuncs, leveraging broadcasting to perform vectorized computations across compatible input shapes, often delegating core numerical computations to internal C-extensions (e.g., _cfinancial).
